paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption_used: Massive activation values across layers under baseline conditions, showing four component signals. The ffn_residual (red solid) and attn_residual (orange dotted) lines rise sharply at layer 5 to approximately 1400, with ffn_residual maintaining values between 1400 and 1600 through layer 20 before declining. The attn_residual closely mirrors ffn_residual but with a one-layer rightward shift. The ffn_output (green dash-dot) exhibits periodic spikes at layers 5, 13, and 22, reaching peak values of approximately 800. The attn_output (blue dashed) remains near zero throughout all layers, with no notable increase at any point in the network. The data indicates that massive activations in the baseline are driven primarily by the feed-forward network residual stream, with attention outputs contributing negligibly.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата илюстрира промените в максималните стойности на активациите (Max Activation Value) по слоевете (Layer) в базовата конфигурация на модела, като показва четири отделни компонента. Оста X е обозначена като „Layer“ и използва линейна скала, обхващаща диапазона от 0 до 22, с етикети, разположени през интервали от 5 единици. Оста Y е обозначена като „Max Activation Value“ и също използва линейна скала, обхващаща диапазона от 0 до 1600, с етикети през интервали от 200 единици.

На графиката са представени четири линии, всяка със специфичен стил и цвят, както е посочено в легендата: „attn_output“ (синя пунктирена линия), „attn_residual“ (оранжева точкочертична линия), „ffn_output“ (зелена пунктирно-чертова линия) и „ffn_residual“ (червена сплошна линия).

Линията „ffn_residual“ (червена сплошна) започва със стойност близо до 0 при слой 0 и остава незначителна до слой 5, където рязко нараства до около 1400. След това стойността се стабилизира между 1400 и 1600 до слой 20, след което рязко пада към около 400 при слой 22. Линията „attn_residual“ (оранжева точкочертична) има сходен профил, но с едно-слойно закъснение: тя започва да нараства от слой 6, достига около 1400 при слой 7, остава стабилна до слой 21 и след това пада. Линията „ffn_output“ (зелена пунктирно-чертова) започва с нулева стойност, има периодични върхове при слоеве 5, 13 и 22, достигайки максимум около 800 при всеки от тези слоеве, а между тях стойността е близо до 0. Линията „attn_output“ (синя пунктирена) остава близо до 0 през целия диапазон на слоевете, без забележимо увеличение във всички точки.
model_annotations.Chinese: The chart titled "Massive Activation of baseline" displays the maximum activation values across layers for four distinct component signals in a neural network under baseline conditions. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is linearly scaled from 0 to 22, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Max Activation Value," is also linearly scaled from 0 to 1600, with tick marks at intervals of 200. Four lines are plotted: the red solid line labeled "ffn_residual" begins near 0 at layer 0, rises sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, remains between 1400 and 1600 from layer 5 to layer 20, and then drops to around 400 at layer 22. The orange dotted line labeled "attn_residual" starts near 0, rises to approximately 1400 at layer 6, stays near that value through layer 20, and then decreases to around 400 at layer 22. The green dash-dot line labeled "ffn_output" remains near 0 until layer 5, where it spikes to approximately 800, drops back to near 0 at layer 7, rises again to approximately 800 at layer 13, drops to near 0 at layer 15, and spikes once more to approximately 800 at layer 22. The blue dashed line labeled "attn_output" remains near 0 across all layers, with no significant increase at any point.
model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the maximum activation values across layers for four different components under baseline conditions in a large language model, with the x-axis labeled "Layer" ranging from 0 to 22 in increments of 5 on a linear scale, and the y-axis labeled "Max Activation Value" ranging from 0 to 1600 in increments of 200 on a linear scale. The red solid line, representing `ffn_residual`, remains near zero until layer 5, where it rises sharply to approximately 1400, then increases slightly to around 1600 by layer 10, maintaining values between 1400 and 1600 through layer 20 before dropping sharply after layer 20. The orange dotted line, `attn_residual`, follows a similar pattern but is delayed by one layer: it remains near zero until layer 6, rises to approximately 1400, stays near that value through layer 21, and then declines. The green dash-dot line, `ffn_output`, remains near zero for most layers, exhibiting sharp peaks at layers 5 (approximately 800), 13 (approximately 800), and 22 (approximately 800), with minimal activity in between. The blue dashed line, `attn_output`, remains near zero across all layers, showing no significant increase at any point.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt die maximalen Aktivierungswerte über die Schichten eines neuronalen Netzwerks unter Baseline-Bedingungen, wobei vier verschiedene Komponentensignale dargestellt sind. Die x-Achse repräsentiert die Schichtnummer (Layer) mit einem linearen Maßstab, der von 0 bis über 22 reicht, wobei die Tick-Beschriftungen in regelmäßigen Abständen von 5 beginnend bei 0 angezeigt werden. Die y-Achse gibt den Maximalwert der Aktivierung an, ebenfalls auf einem linearen Maßstab, der von 0 bis 1600 reicht, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in Schritten von 200. Die rote durchgezogene Linie (ffn_residual) bleibt bei 0 bis zur Schicht 5, steigt dann abrupt auf etwa 1400 an und bleibt zwischen 1400 und 1600 konstant bis zur Schicht 20, bevor sie ab Schicht 21 wieder stark abfällt und bei Schicht 22 auf etwa 500 sinkt. Die orangefarbene gepunktete Linie (attn_residual) verläuft ähnlich, bleibt bis Schicht 6 bei 0, steigt dann auf etwa 1400 an und bleibt bis Schicht 21 stabil, bevor sie ab Schicht 22 ebenfalls abfällt; sie ist gegenüber der roten Linie um eine Schicht nach rechts verschoben. Die grüne gestrichelte Linie (ffn_output) bleibt bis Schicht 5 bei 0, zeigt dann einen plötzlichen Anstieg auf etwa 800, fällt wieder auf 0, steigt erneut bei Schicht 13 auf etwa 800, fällt wieder ab, und zeigt einen weiteren Anstieg bei Schicht 22 auf etwa 800. Die blaue gestrichelte Linie (attn_output) bleibt über alle Schichten hinweg nahe bei 0, ohne signifikante Erhöhungen oder Veränderungen.
